build_composite_optimizer: build a FairseqCompositeOptimizer that groups parameters and assigns different optimizers per group
create_optimizer_config: create a CompositeOptimizerConfig dataclass to configure per-group optimizer and lr scheduler settings
create_lr_scheduler: create a CompositeLRScheduler to manage multiple per-group learning rate schedulers together
review_optimizer_step: review the CompositeOptimizer step method that delegates optimization steps to each grouped optimizer
test_load_state_dict: test the FairseqCompositeOptimizer load_state_dict method to restore optimizer state per group
